archive87.method: World x of each native wheel cylinder center plus its bounding-sphere radius. Below-toe upper bounds rule out a loaded contact beyond the toe at that stored endpoint.

sensor_readback.fixed_history: Original 88 C++ decisions, proprioception and issued action history

training_contacts_readback.method: Cold forward dynamics from recorded qpos, qvel and last applied PD torques, using the frozen illegal-contact classifier. Its recorded interval flag is an OR over ten native steps and the final boundary. Only 20 ms endpoints are stored; original solver warm-starts, substep forces and the first offending part within an interval are unavailable.
